meta.name: offensive-bluetooth-ble
meta.description: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) attack methodology — GATT enumeration, characteristic read/write without auth, pairing downgrade (Just Works forced), LE Secure Connections bypass, MITM via active relay, sniffing with Sniffle (TI CC1352) / Ubertooth / Frontline, encryption key extraction (LE Legacy Pairing crackable, LE Secure Connections strong), proximity authentication abuse (cars, locks), and companion-app trust analysis. Use for IoT BLE devices, smart locks, fitness trackers, medical devices, BLE beacons, or any device pairing over BLE.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会指导你如何发现并攻击低功耗蓝牙（BLE）设备，包括枚举 GATT 服务、读写未授权特征值、降级配对方式、嗅探配对过程、中间人攻击以及逆向分析配套 App。
howto.when: 当你需要测试 IoT 设备（如智能锁、手环、医疗设备）的 BLE 安全性时触发。

say.text: 帮我枚举附近 BLE 设备的 GATT 服务。
如何测试智能锁的解锁特征值是否可未授权写入？
say.note: Claude 会提供读写特征值的具体步骤。

say.text: 用 crackle 破解 LE Legacy Pairing 的 LTK。
say.note: Claude 会说明如何嗅探配对包并运行 crackle。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through attacking Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices: GATT enumeration, unauthorized characteristic read/write, pairing downgrade, sniffing, MITM, and companion app reverse engineering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to test the BLE security of IoT devices such as smart locks, fitness trackers, or medical devices.

say_en.text: Help me enumerate GATT services of nearby BLE devices.
say_en.note: Claude will provide commands using bettercap or gatttool.

say_en.text: How to test if a smart lock's unlock characteristic is writable without auth?
say_en.note: Claude will give steps to read/write characteristics.

say_en.text: Use crackle to crack the LTK from LE Legacy Pairing.
say_en.note: Claude will explain how to sniff pairing packets and run crackle.
